Nunito Sans — SIL Open Font License 1.1; see NunitoSans-OFL.txt.
Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/nunitosans
Downloaded 2026-11-10 from Google Fonts' public font repository.
Source variable file: NunitoSans[YTLC,opsz,wdth,wght].ttf.
Derived static weights: Regular 400, Semibold 600, Bold 700.
All other variation axes fixed at their source default values using fontTools 4.63.0.
These local static instances are bundled for consistent Unity font import and dynamic TMP atlases.
